title: Global real-weather test dataset (16 Nov 2026)

engine_tested.note: Runner imports the engine read-only. site/engine/* is not modified.

date_range_requested.taf_us: IEM AFOS full raw TAF text, same 12-month window as METARs

EGLL.climate: Atlantic maritime, fog and winter rain

EHAM.climate: North Sea, low cloud and wind

DNMM.climate: West Africa, wet season, harmattan dust

SLLP.climate: very high elevation (La Paz / El Alto)

ogimet.note: Ogimet often only returns ~36 hours; older windows may be empty.

limitations: No report was invented or synthesized.
International TAF history from aviationweather.gov is about 30 days, not 12 months.
IEM AFOS TAF text covers US NWS products (K*/PA*/PH*/some Caribbean) for the 12-month window.
Ogimet was used only as a recent complement; older Ogimet windows are often empty.
South African FA** stations are omitted here; they already have their own 12-month set.
